title: Accrued fees become stuck when gauge is killed
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  The internal `_claimFees()` function, responsible for claiming these fees, is only invoked during reward notifications via `notifyRewardAmount()`.
